comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
Made using the recipe
Sewing Robes for the Nobility
Patterns for sewing the long robes worn by people of high rank.

Sewing r0 required
Consumption Contribution 300, Cost 97500 Ducats
40 Cotton Fabric + 10 Exquisite velvet + 10 Fine fur

Produces Houpelande
+1 Frugality
+1 Caution
Required Total Fame 3000
No gender restrictions

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
The recipe can be found in chamber of commerce in Florence during the 4th period of the 15th century.
It looks very weird/funny, but it is not very useful. It is not worth the exquisite velvet and fine fur I think. Mine is for sale (ign: Destry)
